summary: Work start moves the calling session into the claimed worktree instead of launching a new one. Claim precedes movement, so a failed move remains resumable. Missing host movement refuses without a launch fallback. The default checkout stays clean; movement carries no changes, takes effect next turn and verifies the landed directory. Session preparation checks primary definitions and coordinator identity, not retired worker lanes.
title: Retarget the running session at work start instead of launching one
